title: 601. ClawHub Skill Market In-Depth Analysis - Wiki | clawbot
snippet: Market Performance: Explosive growth in the number of skills, with a monthly growth rate exceeding 100%. Multiple third-party indexing sites (e.g., awesome-openclaw-skills, claw-hub.net) aggregate ClawHub data. Forms a complementary ecosystem with third-party marketplaces like Smithery and LobeHub.

title: ClawHub By the Numbers: What 52,652 Skills Reveal | Trent AI
snippet: An analysis of every package in the ClawHub registry, the largest marketplace for AI agent skills. It reveals an ecosystem that's exploding in scale, dominated by a handful of mass-publishers, and failing every classical software-supply-chain assumption at once.
